subject: general
question: ‘Wings of Fire’ is the autobiography of a former president of India. Who is he?
solution:
The correct answer is __**APJ Abdul Kalam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **APJ Abdul Kalam** is the author of the book 'Wings of Fire'.
 
• He served as the **11th President of India** from 2002 to 2007.
 
• APJ Abdul Kalam was an **aerospace scientist** and played a pivotal role in India's civilian space program and military missile development efforts.
 
• He is fondly referred to as the **"Missile Man of India"** for his work on the development of ballistic missile and launch vehicle technology.
 
• The autobiography **'Wings of Fire'** narrates his early life, effort, hardship, fortitude, luck, and chance that eventually led him to lead Indian space research, nuclear and missile programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **APJ Abdul Kalam** was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian honor, in 1997.
 
• He was involved in India's **Pokhran-II nuclear tests** in 1998, which established India as a nuclear power.
 
• After his tenure as President, he became a visiting professor at several prestigious institutions and continued to inspire millions through his speeches and writings.
 
• His vision for India included **transforming it into a developed nation** by the year 2020 through his plan called **Vision 2020**.
